heroic-inspiration-manager.SettingsHint: Configure the managed Heroic Inspiration item and grant effects.
heroic-inspiration-manager.ProtectPlayer: Block players from editing managed charges and properties
heroic-inspiration-manager.GMDirect: Allow GM to edit the item directly
heroic-inspiration-manager.CombatLock: Block player attunement changes during active combat
heroic-inspiration-manager.FXMissing: Token Magic FX is not active or installed. Install and enable it to unlock this option.
heroic-inspiration-manager.MigrationNote: Set exact is an administrative migration operation; it does not play sound or FX.
heroic-inspiration-manager.ConfirmExact: Set the current balance for actors
heroic-inspiration-manager.GMOnly: Only a GM can manage inspiration.
heroic-inspiration-manager.NameConflict: An unmanaged item has the same name. Resolve it before installing.
heroic-inspiration-manager.Busy: This actor or item is already being updated.
heroic-inspiration-manager.MustEquip: Equip Heroic Inspiration before using it.
heroic-inspiration-manager.MustAttune: Attune Heroic Inspiration before using it.
heroic-inspiration-manager.MissingActivity: The managed Activity is missing; ask the GM to synchronize the item.
heroic-inspiration-manager.Protected: The GM manages this Heroic Inspiration item.
heroic-inspiration-manager.CombatAttunementBlocked: Players cannot change attunement during combat.
heroic-inspiration-manager.StarHint: Use Heroic Inspiration from the managed item
heroic-inspiration-manager.ItemDescription: An inspiring spark of heroic resolve. Use its Utility Activity to declare Heroic Inspiration.
heroic-inspiration-manager.SelectToken: Select a token on the canvas to test FX.
heroic-inspiration-manager.SyncScopeHint: Characters are synchronized by default. Check this option to include NPCs. Existing balances are preserved.
heroic-inspiration-manager.RestGrantIdentifiersHint: Structured feature identifiers (comma-separated) that grant +1 Heroic Inspiration after a Long Rest. Default: resourceful. These are Item identifiers, not displayed names.
